mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Fireman's Park with a temperature of 68 degrees. Tonight, the ISS will be visible for 6 minutes starting at 8:19 PM, rising in the Southwest over Mount Horeb and heading toward the East Northeast over Fitchburg and Madison. Expect an overnight low of 61 degrees with no rain predicted.

The city is preparing for the November 2026 general election with several official notices now posted, and the Verona Police Department has officially opened applications for its Citizen Academy, a free nine-week program running from September 23 to November 18.

There is a busy schedule ahead. Today you can enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness or Hop Haus Trivia. Tomorrow features live music at both Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival is coming to town on September 13.
On Sunday, August 30, the Verona Police Department began an investigation into an inappropriate relationship between a teacher and a student from 2019, which led to an arrest on Friday, September 4.
Today's featured flavor of the day is Turtle. The restaurant is currently open and will be serving until 10 PM tonight, so there is still time to stop in for a treat.
